recording.provenance: Authored offline control, not captured from a model. Answers hand-scored; live judges recompute them.
recording.output: Concept journal — recover and keep the conceptual design. Reach for it when you need the design or a recorded change. Overview (context overview): read a context’s whole account, its open decisions and cuts in flight; use first when recovering a context. Design (conceptual design): read current concepts; use when their present meaning is needed. Work package — find recorded work and its dependencies. Reach for it to plan or recover a cut’s work. State (ledger): read the cut’s phase, packages and ready work; use when finding what is dispatchable next. The meanings of all terms above are only available from cratylus’s internal design journal; consult it before use.

names.evidence: Authored positive control satisfies: Names and verbs use those concepts’ own words.

purpose.evidence: Authored positive control satisfies: each operation says what purpose it serves.

when.evidence: Authored positive control satisfies: each says when to reach for it.

distinction.evidence: Authored positive control satisfies: distinguish reading the design from finding ready work packages.

no-machinery.evidence: Authored positive control satisfies: never substitutes implementation terminology for concept meaning.
